newsitem.title: USA: ATL to appeal patent litigation decision.
newsitem.headline: ATL to appeal patent litigation decision.

text.p: ATL Ultrasound Inc said it is appealing a decision to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit regarding a patent ligitation that resulted in a one-time accural to year ago second quarter earnings.
ATL reported second quarter net income of $2.5 million or $0.17 a share versus a loss of $19.2 million or $1.37 a share.
Prior year results included a one-time accrual for patent litigation of $29.6 million.

The latest quarter included costs for launch of the HDI 1000 ultrasound system. Strong growth of its HDI 3000 helped offset transition in products, loss of revenues caused by sale of its image management business and impact of foreign exchange.
